All 32 legal replies allow a verified local material gain or mate, including captures and counterchecks. This proves a material concession, not a forced-mate claim; later mechanisms belong to their actual moves.

motifs.label: Deflection

motifs.label: Mating Deflection
motifs.evidence: Qxf7+ offers the queen to deflect the rook from f8. Accepting with Rxf7 allows a verified mate starting with Rd8+ (Rf8 Rfxf8#): the defender no longer guards d8. The other legal replies also allow immediate mate; for example, Kh8 Qxf8#. Every legal defence permits mate. This is the supporting mechanism, not an extra material win.

motifs.label: Double Threat
motifs.evidence: Nd7 attacks the rook on b6 and threatens Nf6+, a checking fork of the queen on h5 and king on g8. After Kg7, Nxb6 wins material; after Rc6, Nf6+ uses the fork instead. All 35 legal replies allow a verified material gain, including captures and counterchecks. This is a double threat now; the fork occurs on the next move only if that branch is played.
